start.title: [TODO:ko] Famine in the Land
start.text:
[TODO:ko] Foreigners come daily for grain.
A new group bows before your dais.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Wave them off, you are busy

wave_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Look Again
wave_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Something pulls your eye back.
Those beards, that posture…

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You step down from the dais.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Steady Yourself
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Their voices reach you. Hebrew.
Your heart begins to pound.

recognize.title: [TODO:ko] It Is Them
recognize.text:
[TODO:ko] Reuben. Judah. Levi. All ten.
They do not know you.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Hide your face and test them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] You must know if they have changed.

reveal_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Too Soon
reveal_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Their hearts are not yet known.
Is Benjamin safe? Is father alive?

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Hide your face and test them

arrest_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] A Cold Heart
arrest_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Anger burns — but God put you here
for more than revenge.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Hide your face and test them

hide_face.title: [TODO:ko] A Stranger's Voice
hide_face.text:
[TODO:ko] Through an interpreter you speak harsh.
"Where do you come from?"

skip_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Hold the Plan
skip_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] If you skip the test now,
you will never know their hearts.

spy_accusation.title: [TODO:ko] "You Are Spies!"
spy_accusation.text:
[TODO:ko] You point and roar the word.
The brothers fall to their knees.

smile_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Mask On
smile_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] You must not soften yet.
The test is only beginning.

they_protest.title: [TODO:ko] Their Defense
they_protest.text:
[TODO:ko] "We are twelve sons. One is no more.
The youngest is with our father."

pretend_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Steady
pretend_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Without Benjamin, the test fails.
You must press on.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Bite Your Tongue
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Mocking the lost wounds father too.
You pull the words back.

demand_benjamin.title: [TODO:ko] Three Days' Hold
demand_benjamin.text:
[TODO:ko] "You will be held three days.
Then one fetches the youngest."

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Lock them all in the chamber

free_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Hold the Line
free_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Without pressure, the truth hides.
Three days will reveal much.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Lock them all in the chamber

three_days.title: [TODO:ko] Third Morning
three_days.text:
[TODO:ko] Three days have weighed on them.
Now you offer a softer terms.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Keep one, send the rest with grain

all_stay_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Be Just
all_stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Their wives and children would die.
God would not honor that.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Keep one, send the rest with grain

keep_one.title: [TODO:ko] Their Confession
keep_one.text:
[TODO:ko] They speak among themselves, not knowing
you understand every word.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Listen
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] These are the words you waited
twenty years to hear.

overhear.title: [TODO:ko] "This Is For Joseph"
overhear.text:
[TODO:ko] "We sinned against our brother.
We saw his anguish and would not hear."

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Show your tears in front of them

tears_open_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Yet
tears_open_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] They would see and the test
would be undone too soon.

weep_alone.title: [TODO:ko] Choose Simeon
weep_alone.text:
[TODO:ko] You return composed. Now choose
which brother to hold.

reuben_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Not Reuben
reuben_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Reuben spoke for you long ago.
Let justice fall on another.

bind_simeon.title: [TODO:ko] Simeon Bound
bind_simeon.text:
[TODO:ko] Ropes circle his wrists. He goes
without protest. The brothers pale.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Order their sacks filled with grain
[TODO:ko] Send them empty, to teach a lesson

empty_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Mercy Returns
empty_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Famine kills children too.
Give them what they came for.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Order their sacks filled with grain

fill_sacks.title: [TODO:ko] Silver Returned
fill_sacks.text:
[TODO:ko] You whisper to the steward:
"Put each man's silver back in his sack."

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Take the silver as fair pay
[TODO:ko] Hide it deep within the grain
[TODO:ko] Toss it openly into their cart

silver_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] No Profit
silver_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] You will not take from your father's house.
Return it in secret.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Hide it deep within the grain

open_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Hidden, Not Open
open_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] An open gift would frighten them.
Better discovered later.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Hide it deep within the grain

silver_hidden.title: [TODO:ko] Provision for the Road
silver_hidden.text:
[TODO:ko] The steward also packs food
for the long journey home.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Send them off with no warning

no_warning_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Make It Clear
no_warning_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] If they forget the terms,
the test cannot be completed.

send_off.title: [TODO:ko] They Depart
send_off.text:
[TODO:ko] Donkeys laden, the nine ride out.
From your window, you watch.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Run after them and confess all

run_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Hold the Plan
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Father's heart, Benjamin's safety —
the test must be finished.

first_camp.title: [TODO:ko] Camp at Dusk
first_camp.text:
[TODO:ko] Far away, the brothers stop.
One opens his sack for grain.

silver_found.title: [TODO:ko] "What Has God Done?"
silver_found.text:
[TODO:ko] They tremble. "What is this God
has done to us?" they cry.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] They will turn back in panic

press_on.title: [TODO:ko] Onward to Canaan
press_on.text:
[TODO:ko] Fear pushes them home.
Father is waiting.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Speak True
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Father will see the missing son.
A lie will only deepen the pain.

tell_jacob.title: [TODO:ko] Father Hears
tell_jacob.text:
[TODO:ko] Jacob's hand trembles at his chest.
"Joseph is gone. Simeon now too…"

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Be Gentle
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Shouting will not heal a father
who has buried a son in his heart.

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Stay With Him
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Leaving solves nothing.
Father needs a steady son now.

promise_jacob.title: [TODO:ko] Jacob Refuses
promise_jacob.text:
[TODO:ko] "My son shall not go down with you."
The grain bag empties slowly.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Wait for the famine to speak.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Wait until the grain runs out

force_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Patience
force_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Father will not be forced.
God's time will come.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Wait until the grain runs out

wait_famine.title: [TODO:ko] Sacks Run Empty
wait_famine.text:
[TODO:ko] Weeks pass. The last grain is gone.
Father summons his sons.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Stay silent and let Reuben speak
[TODO:ko] Boast you can fix it alone

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Quiet, Brother
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Father needs a pledge, not a boast.
Let Judah speak.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Stay silent and let Judah speak

judah_speaks.title: [TODO:ko] Judah's Pledge
judah_speaks.text:
[TODO:ko] "Send the boy with me. I will be
surety. On me alone the blame."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] His pledge is a true one.

mock_judah_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Hush
mock_judah_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] This is the moment of pledge.
Do not break it with mockery.

father_relents.title: [TODO:ko] "If I Am Bereaved…"
father_relents.text:
[TODO:ko] "Take double silver. Take a gift.
And may God Almighty give you mercy."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ko] Father said double — and a gift.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Prepare double silver and a gift

stingy_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Honor Father
stingy_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Father has spoken with care.
Obey him in full.

choices.text: [TODO:ko] Prepare double silver and a gift

preparation.title: [TODO:ko] Donkeys Loaded
preparation.text:
[TODO:ko] Benjamin tightens his sash.
The road south waits in the dust.

no_pray_consequence.title: [TODO:ko] Pray First
no_pray_consequence.text:
[TODO:ko] Egypt is far. The vizier is harsh.
Ask God's mercy now.

ending.title: [TODO:ko] Toward Egypt Again
ending.text:
[TODO:ko] Eleven brothers ride south.
A strange vizier waits — and watches.
